dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: Welcome to "Wild Kazakhstan" — a journey through the most spectacular and least-explored natural landscapes on Earth.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Wow, even the introduction is incredible. I had no idea Kazakhstan had so much wild nature.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: Our first stop is the Altai Mountains — home to the most elusive predator in Asia: the snow leopard.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: Look at it! It's the most beautiful animal I've ever seen. And those enormous paws!

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: The Altai snow leopard has adapted to the harshest conditions imaginable. Temperatures here drop to minus forty degrees in winter.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Minus forty? That's absolutely freezing! How does it survive?

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: Its fur is the thickest of any wild cat — up to twelve centimetres deep in winter. It also has the longest tail relative to its body size.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: It's completely wild and free. That's the most moving thing — something so magnificent existing so far from human reach.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: We now travel south to the vast Kazakh steppe — one of the largest grasslands on the planet. Here, a tiny dot on the horizon reveals itself...

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Is that the saiga? It looks tiny from here but the herd is enormous — there must be thousands of them!

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: This is the world's largest remaining herd of saiga antelope — nearly one million animals moving together across the steppe.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: I'm speechless. This is the most spectacular thing I've ever watched. Why don't people know about this?

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: Kazakhstan is one of the best-kept secrets of the natural world. Its wildlife is extraordinary — and worth every effort to protect.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: I've decided. After this degree, I'm applying for a conservation internship. This is too important to ignore.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: I'll come with you! The most beautiful things in the world deserve the most passionate defenders.
